summary: BAILE, a small Brazilian funk rhythm instrument with three kits (Tamborzão, Voltmix and Beat Bolha), each with four parts and a one-bar step pattern.
features: Three kits, one playing at a time; 12 embedded samples
Four parts per kit, steps toggled on the 16 white keys
Knobs for saturator, reverb, tempo and swing
Edits live in RAM only; reboot restores factory patterns
Shrinks the user storage area; migration from other firmware unvalidated
Browser preview runs the same application code
